tools.name: get_farm_times_article

tools.name: get_quailos_tv
tools.description: Get one QuailOS TV video by doc id or YouTube videoId. Non-approved hidden unless SuperAdmin.

tools.name: list_academy_courses
tools.description: List published QuailOS Academy courses (excludes Rent-a-Hatch category). Read-only. Includes price/freeForTiers hints.

tools.name: get_academy_course
tools.description: Get one published Academy course with modules/lessons metadata. Media (videoId, pdfUrl) is only returned for free-preview lessons or enrolled/tutor farms with a valid AI key; locked lessons return teasers.

tools.name: list_my_academy_enrollments
tools.description: List this farm's Academy enrollments/progress (read-only). To enroll in a course, use enroll_academy_course.

tools.name: enroll_academy_course
tools.description: Enroll this farm in a free QuailOS Academy course (or preview free eligibility for plan tier). Requires owner, admin, or manager role. Paid courses return payment link and cannot be auto-enrolled via MCP.

tools.name: list_library_items

tools.name: get_library_item

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "send_email" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

evidence.snippet: send_email

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "message" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_support_tickets, reply_to_ticket, get_ticket_thread, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, get_feed_inventory, list_emails, get_email, draft_email_reply, move_email, send_email, list_rentahatch_waitlist, list_rentahatch_bookings, list_library_items, get_library_item · Private data: start_signup, list_vehicles, get_support_tickets, get_feature_requests, get_ticket_thread, get_hatches, log_varroa_treatment, get_tasks, get_calendar_events, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, get_meat_inventory, get_beekeeping_apiary, get_financial_pnl, get_feed_inventory, get_vendors_and_pos, get_egg_collections, log_time, log_meat, get_email · Public sink: start_signup, create_feature_request, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, list_emails, get_email, draft_email_reply, move_email, send_email, list_rentahatch_bookings · Destructive: delete_task, delete_calendar_event, update_rentahatch_waitlist_status, delete_farm_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_support_tickets, reply_to_ticket, get_ticket_thread, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, get_feed_inventory, list_emails, get_email, draft_email_reply, move_email, send_email, list_rentahatch_waitlist, list_rentahatch_bookings, list_library_items, get_library_item · Private data: start_signup, list_vehicles, get_support_tickets, get_feature_requests, get_ticket_thread, get_hatches, log_varroa_treatment, get_tasks, get_calendar_events, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, get_meat_inventory, get_beekeeping_apiary, get_financial_pnl, get_feed_inventory, get_vendors_and_pos, get_egg_collections, log_time, log_meat, get_email · Public sink: start_signup, create_feature_request, get_orders, get_order_feedback, get_customer_details, list_emails, get_email, draft_email_reply, move_email, send_email, list_rentahatch_bookings · Destructive: delete_task, delete_calendar_event, update_rentahatch_waitlist_status, delete_farm_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
